display.title: Episode 419: The Purim Mitzvah Chart, Songs and Graggers (Purim)
display.summary_short: A pre-Purim show: the four mitzvos of Purim, Purim songs with graggers, Kabbalas ol malchus Shamayim in the Shema, and a song for Uvnei Yerushalayim.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week before Purim 5750. Uncle Yossi walks through the Tzivos Hashem Purim mitzvah chart: hearing every word of the Megillah (this year read on Motzei Shabbos and Sunday morning), using the gragger only at the signal, sending mishloach manos, giving matanos la'evyonim, and holding a Purim seudah. He urges children to invite a friend who knows little about Purim, just as Mordechai gathered thousands of Jewish children to learn Torah and brought the Purim salvation. A guest singer in Studio 604 leads Purim songs while listeners practice with their graggers. Mitzvah Time teaches the words Kabbalas ol malchus Shamayim: like a horse that wears a yoke, we accept Hashem as our King, especially when we say Baruch Shem after the Shema. A young listener answers questions in a phone call and leads the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Uncle Yossi links Purim to the Beis HaMikdash and teaches a tune for Uvnei Yerushalayim to sing after benching at the Purim seudah. The show ends with memorial dedications, candle-lighting time and a Purim greeting.
display.lesson: Do all the mitzvos of Purim with joy, share them with a friend, and accept Hashem as our King every time we say the Shema.

date.note: Megillah is read 'this coming Shabbos night', the night after 13 Adar; Purim 5750 fell on Sunday 11 March 1990, so the Tuesday show was 6 March, matching the weekly estimate.

privacy.note: Guest singer and a child on the telephone quiz and Shema named in full.
